summary.zh-CN: 可在 DSH Web 任意位置拖拽且始终置顶的透明浮空 3D 虚拟人物；单击开始语音聊天，双击打开设置面板，支持人物角色、聊天背景、音色切换和流式实时回复。
summary.en-US: An always-on-top transparent draggable 3D human companion for DSH Web; click to start proactive voice chat, double-click to open settings for role, background, voice, and streaming replies.

network: Local DSH web profile HTTP route prefix /virtual-companion only
Outbound WebSocket to Microsoft Edge Read Aloud TTS endpoint (wss://speech.platform.bing.com/consumer/speech/synthesize/readaloud/edge/v1) for neural Chinese voice synthesis
